purpose: Standard-LIBERO closed loop of the calibrated LAQ W4A4KV4 arms (laq-fastwam-20261111, laq-cosmos-20261111) on the four original suites: 40 tasks x 21 official initial states = 840 episodes per model, run on the NTU EEE cluster. Seeds are fixed per episode index so BF16 and baseline runs under this protocol pair episode by episode.

benchmark.name: LIBERO (original four suites)
benchmark.index: i = 210 * suite + 21 * task + trial, suites in the order above
benchmark.initial_state: official original-LIBERO initial_states[trial] of the task
benchmark.success: environment done flag (task success) within max_steps policy steps after settling

gates.note: The A100 anchors cannot be matched bitwise on another GPU model. BF16 drift (this GPU vs the A100 BF16 anchor) must be at most bf16_drift_fraction of the A100 LAQ damage; the LAQ damage on this GPU (vs this GPU's BF16 anchor) must be within damage_ratio of the A100 LAQ damage. Within one GPU model every worker must reproduce the first worker's arm anchor bitwise.
